scope: Finalized HB target/CSV/source/calibration audit only. Private test GT prevents official local pose scoring. No GT poses, evaluator, remote submission, locks, inference, GPU or worker jobs are invoked.

audit.denominator_policy: Unmodified complete official localization targets, including blocked and failed rows

denominator.derivation: Explicit sum of inst_count from the unchanged original official target JSON.
denominator.interpretation: Output counts are execution diagnostics, not GT-based pose accuracy or recall.

identity_verification.recorded_sensor_modes: All300 sources record uint8 RGB with uint16 depth from test_primesense. Actual sensor scaling/point mapping checks remain the prior three-case sample report.
identity_verification.scope_limit: All saved sensor fingerprints are joined to the retained acquisition manifest. Raw RGB/depth decodes or full raw-image rehashes are not repeated.

reason.reason: Official public test GT poses/info are withheld; generate valid predictions but local VSD/MSSD/MSPD scores are unavailable. Official BOP evaluation service is the supported scoring route.

evaluation_unavailability.remote_submission_note: No submission is made here. No local official scores are available.

runtime_scope.policy: Saved current image wall time plus retained completed-candidate compute time; interruption downtime excluded. Includes recorded failed work. Excludes CAD onboarding and evaluation.

target_required_CAD_onboarding.scope: Sum of saved completed-stage active runtimes; partial progress is separate. Failed/unfinished CAD work after its last checkpoint, including a failing GeDi tail, is not fully logged and is not included.

prior_separate_reviews.scope: Prior separate scoped evidence, not repeated.

preservation_action: Only this new separate audit JSON is written. Existing inputs, source, features, predictions, receipts, scores, blockers, primary summaries and status are unchanged. Prior candidate/visual reports and all-CAD deep checks are not repeated.
